title: Completar L1: LangGraph Governed Execution
scope_decision: Intentional extension of L1 to compose existing L4 GovernedRAG and L11 SandboxManager for end-to-end evidence; their contracts/statuses remain unchanged. Approval demonstration is request/workspace-bound LangGraph pause/resume and does not establish authenticated production identity. A reproducible demo transcript and receipts satisfy the historical video/demo deliverable; no video claim unless recorded.
verification_boundary: L1 VALIDATED for the explicitly bounded local scope after 210 complete tests, 29 focused tests, README generation/check, compileall, five-case demo receipts and independent review with no P0/P1; production identity, durable replay protection, OS/network isolation, remote providers, Jaeger and video remain unclaimed.
